edits: Country Fields
N for corrections, M for arrears, J
N for corrections, E for a late payment (type M only for periods before health period March 2014 with a total absence of payment), J
Country Option Mappers
Periods with a total absence of payment. The operator computes interest on arrears.

Periods before health period March 2014 with a total absence of payment (AT2 v30 §2.1.1.2.2 campo 8, type M). A late payment for a later period is filed on type E, on which the operador computes the interest on arrears.
Country Option Mappers
PILA worker type 12 (academic phase) or 19 (practical phase).

PILA tipo cotizante 19 'Aprendices etapa lectiva Ley 2466 de 2025' for the lectiva phase from the health period of August 2025 (code 12 only for earlier periods). For health periods before August 2025, code 19 covers the productive phase; from the health period of August 2025, AT2 v30 names no code for the productive phase (AT2 v30 §2.1.2.3.1 campo 5, types 12 and 19).
Country Option Mappers
Apprentice, classroom phase. Reduced contribution scenario - health only in the academic phase phase.
Apprentice, lectiva phase (electronic payroll table 5.5.3). In PILA, code 12 applies only to health periods before August 2025: health only, IBC 1 SMMLV (AT2 v30 §2.1.2.3.1 campo 5, type 12).
Country Option Mappers
Apprentice, productive phase. Full contribution scenario.

Apprentice, productive phase (electronic payroll table 5.5.3). In PILA, code 19 is 'Aprendices etapa lectiva Ley 2466 de 2025' from the health period of August 2025: health and occupational risk only, IBC 1 SMMLV; it covers the productive phase only for health periods before August 2025 (AT2 v30 §2.1.2.3.1 campo 5, type 19). The electronic payroll code and the PILA code are mapped separately.

vc.desc: PILA return types: E for a late payment, M only for periods before health period March 2014 (Country Fields W80, Country Option Mappers F221). Apprentice PILA codes under Ley 2466 de 2025 (Country Option Mappers F60, F65, F66).
